en: Vintage monochrome illustrated postcard with ornate floral borders. It shows three vignettes: at top left a hilltop castle labeled "Castello da Pena"; at top right a palace in a wooded park labeled "Monserat" with people strolling in the gardens; at bottom left a closer view of the same ornate palace façade labeled "Monserat." Decorative script in the center reads "Recordação de Cintra" with ample blank space and lines on the right for address and message.
